scenario: A `where` reads the captures of its own pattern and of earlier ones ([LGRA.8.6]'s ladder); before its pattern a capture has nothing to read, because the fact holding the subject has not joined. Pin: `Dev d where d.id == dev` ahead of the `Log` pattern that binds `dev` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING. Path: `dsc.validate.lreg_4_1_capture_order`.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

schema Dev scope logical:
    id: String key

rule r:
    Dev d where d.id == dev
    Log e where (dev) = e.msg ~ /(\w+)/
->
    log info "{dev}"
